description: Pause a connected account’s queue for 1 to 168 hours (default 24) so scheduled posts wait instead of sending during a network cooldown, security check or manual pause. Queued posts stay intact and resume automatically when heldUntil passes or when accounts_resume is called (posts held more than 7 days past their scheduled time expire). Ask the user before holding an account.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

hours.description: How long to hold queued posts on this account, from 1 to 168 hours. Defaults to 24.

id.description: A connected account id from accounts_list.

reason.description: Optional short note explaining why the account is paused, up to 200 characters.

name: accounts_hold
title: Hold an account’s queue
